spec_match.rationale: Builds exactly what the IDL partial accepts — setConstraints(optional MediaTrackConstraintSet = {}) per media_track_element_constraints.idl — and teaches the explainer's constraint-filtering rule (advanced/exact ignored so a click can never die on OverconstrainedError), with the <usermedia> two-kind contrast shown.

interactive.rationale: Every form control re-renders the exact calls live; each constraint key is annotated from a real getSupportedConstraints() read; on supporting engines the sets are applied to live elements inside a try/catch.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises builder + vocabulary check + filtering rule; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Unknown-key handling is explained per WebIDL (ignored, not an error); the unsupported path states plainly that nothing was applied while keeping the vocabulary annotations real.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5153829504024576 and the setConstraints IDL partial directly.

conformance.rationale: The setconstraints-method and constraint-vocabulary-available assertions distil this page's contract.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: entering width/height/frameRate + echoCancellation rendered the exact call pairs, vocabulary annotations came back green from this browser's real getSupportedConstraints() (the sole passing conformance check here), and the status honestly reported nothing was applied. Zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: capelem-workbench-ran asserts with elementsSupported and the built key set.

design_system.rationale: Fieldsets with mono legends, stone output blocks, emerald/rose vocabulary chips (AA on ivory); CSS variables only; inputs ≥44px.

accessibility.rationale: Every control has a real label (for/id); vocabulary state is text inside the label, not colour alone; rendered calls and status are aria-live; numeric inputs carry inputmode.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Two fieldsets collapse to one column under 760px; rows wrap; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Verify the filtering rule observably on Chrome 153+
openQuestions.detail: On a build with the elements, set an impossible width, click the element, and confirm acquisition still succeeds with a filtered value (no OverconstrainedError) — turning the documented rule into a measured one.

guidanceConsulted.query: constraint builder form controls checkbox number inputs mobile layout
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label every control, use numeric inputmode, keep touch targets adequate.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: for/id labels, inputmode=numeric, 44px min-height controls, wrap-friendly rows.

guidanceConsulted.query: live announcement of derived output on input
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce derived views of user input.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Rendered calls block and status are aria-live polite.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the builder renders the IDL-exact setConstraints() calls as you type, the vocabulary annotations are this browser's genuine getSupportedConstraints() readout, and the unsupported engine's not-applied state is stated plainly rather than simulated.
